mapper.update: UPDATE family_relations SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, child_id, relation_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM family_relations WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND child_id = #{childId}

SELECT fr.id AS id, fr.parent_id AS parentId, fr.child_id AS childId, fr.status AS status, p.name AS parentName, c.name AS childName, fr.created_at AS createdAt FROM family_relations fr JOIN users p ON p.id = fr.parent_id JOIN users c ON c.id = fr.child_id WHERE fr.id = #{id}
